Hi Amanda,

Thanks again for applying to the Product QA Lead role and for your interest in Redwood Inference. I’m Logan, the recruiter on this search. We’d love to set up a 30-minute initial phone screen to cover your background, interest in the role, and high-level logistics.

Quick ask: can you share your availability over the next few business days? I can do any of the following windows (times shown in PDT and BST since I know candidates sometimes are remote):

- Mon–Tue (Oct 19–20): 10:00–12:00 PDT / 18:00–20:00 BST
- Wed (Oct 21): 08:30–11:00 PDT / 16:30–19:00 BST
- Thu (Oct 22): 13:00–15:00 PDT / 21:00–23:00 BST

If none of those work, tell me a couple of 30-minute blocks that do and your time zone. We usually include the hiring manager for the initial screen; I’ve cc’d Marissa Cole (hiring manager) so she can hop on the confirmed invite.

Also, if you have an updated CV handy, please attach it (or I can pull what’s in Greenhouse). I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
